# Starter skills

The 15 skills bundled with Indus Agent.

These skills ship with Indus Agent and are copied into every new profile. `indus skills list` shows what a profile has; `/skills` in a chat does the same.

| Skill | Category | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| `data-wrangling` | `data` | Clean and reshape CSV, JSON and Excel data |
| `pdf-and-documents` | `data` | Extract from and assemble PDF and Office documents |
| `indus-guide` | `indus` | Use, configure and extend Indus Agent itself |
| `skill-authoring` | `indus` | Write or improve a SKILL.md for Indus Agent |
| `meeting-notes-to-actions` | `productivity` | Turn meeting notes into decisions and owned actions |
| `scheduling-jobs` | `productivity` | Turn a request into a safe scheduled job |
| `research-with-sources` | `research` | Search, read and cite sources for a question |
| `code-review` | `software-development` | Review a change for correctness, risk and clarity |
| `git-workflow` | `software-development` | Branch, commit, rebase and settle merge conflicts |
| `github-cli` | `software-development` | Work with GitHub issues and pull requests via gh |
| `project-onboarding` | `software-development` | Map an unfamiliar repository before changing it |
| `shell-scripting` | `software-development` | Write safe, repeatable shell scripts |
| `systematic-debugging` | `software-development` | Reproduce, isolate, fix and verify a bug |
| `test-first` | `software-development` | Write a failing test first, then make it pass |
| `writing-clearly` | `writing` | Edit prose for clarity, brevity and the right tone |
